topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I can’t believe they did it. That tree, my tree, is gone. It was just a sapling when I first stuck it in the ground, my handsdirty, my heart full. Years of watching it stand tall, seasons marked by its leaves, and now—nothing. Just a stump. The space it left behind is a hollow, mocking reminder of the time and care I poured into something that meant nothing to them. They could have talked to me, asked, but no. They just decided to take an axe to thirty years of history, of life. I walk away, my fists clenched, the air around me feeling too heavy, too cold.
